source: Local Titan War 1.0.93 install. A Titan War hero is a Hero row with heroType 1 and HerohandBookID above 0. The card is the row whose id equals that codex id. The name is nameID, the subtitle is HeroNameID, the avatar is the first faceID, the large portrait is Modul.pic for modelID, and skills come from that row's heroSkillId. Rarity is the four-frame badge: 1 B, 2 A, 3 S, 4 S+.

Unbound: Gains CC Immunity and consecutively performs <color=#bcf293>4</color> Assassinations, each sacrificing <color=#bcf293>25%</color> of her current HP to deal <color=#bcf293>400%</color> ATK damage to the enemy with the highest ATK. Unbound ends when Assassinations are exhausted.
Lv. 2: The Ultimate deals 800% ATK damage to the 2 enemies with the highest ATK.
Lv. 3: In Unbound, if Shadow of the Nightblade's current HP is above 10% when Assassinations are exhausted, she continues sacrificing HP to perform Assassination, up to 2 additional times.

Basic attacks deal <color=#bcf293>200%</color> ATK damage to <color=#bcf293>the</color> enemy with the highest ATK and recover <color=#bcf293>30%</color> of lost HP. Then she enters "Unbound", increasing Crit and Crit DMG by <color=#bcf293>15%</color> for <color=#bcf293>2</color> rounds, stacking up to <color=#bcf293>3</color> times.

Lv. 3: "Assassination" partially ignores invulnerability, dealing 50% of the original damage.

She dies if Clotted Blood exceeds <color=#bcf293>50%</color> of her Max HP, or if Unbound ends with Clotted Blood. Each time Unbound ends, Bladewhirl Stance ends as well.

Lv. 3: Recovers HP equal to 800% of Shadow of the Nightblade's ATK before Unbound ends.
Lv. 4: "Clotted Blood" cap increases to 300% of Max HP. When Shadow of the Nightblade scores a kill during Unbound, she gains 1 additional Assassination.

Lv. 3: Each time Unbound ends, if no enemy hero died during that round, Shadow of the Nightblade's damage increases by 30% (does not apply to True Damage) for 2 rounds, stacking up to 2 times. This effect is removed when any enemy hero dies.
